title: Granular-Ball Quantum Clustering for Resource-Efficient and Robust Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.06016v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Quantum clustering aims to exploit quantum feature representations to uncover complex data structures beyond conventional Euclidean geometry. Yet this sample-level kernel construction requires O(n^2) quantum circuit executions for n data points, creating a major bottleneck under near-term quantum resource constraints. Prior solutions fail to resolve this efficiency-accuracy dilemma: classical granular-ball clustering reduces sample complexity but relies on Euclidean metrics that cannot capture quantum correlations, while existing quantum compression schemes prioritize efficiency over structural preservation, degrading performance on non-convex or noisy data. Here we propose Granular-Ball Quantum Clustering (GBQC), a framework that tightly couples granular-ball structural abstraction with quantum feature learning. translated_title: 面向资源高效与鲁棒学习的颗粒球量子聚类
translated_abstract: 量子聚类旨在利用量子特征表示来揭示超越传统欧几里得几何的复杂数据结构。然而，这种样本级的核构造需要对 n 个数据点执行 O(n^2) 次量子电路运行，在近期量子资源受限的条件下构成了重大瓶颈。已有的解决方案未能化解这一效率与精度之间的两难困境：经典颗粒球聚类降低了样本复杂度，但依赖的欧几里得度量无法捕捉量子关联；而现有的量子压缩方案则以效率优先、牺牲结构保持，导致在非凸或含噪数据上的性能下降。本文提出颗粒球量子聚类（GBQC），这是一个将颗粒球结构抽象与量子特征学习紧密耦合的框架。GBQC 首先通过一种由 PCA 引导的分裂策略，将原始数据压缩为紧凑且具有代表性的颗粒球，从而减少核（此处摘要原文不完整）……
tldr: 该论文提出颗粒球量子聚类（GBQC）框架，通过PCA引导的颗粒球压缩策略将量子核构造所需的电路执行次数从O(n²)大幅降低，同时保留量子关联结构，实现了资源高效且对非凸、含噪数据鲁棒的量子聚类。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes Granular-Ball Quantum Clustering (GBQC), a framework that compresses raw data into PCA-guided granular balls before quantum kernel construction, drastically reducing quantum circuit executions from O(n²) while preserving quantum correlations, enabling resource-efficient and robust clustering on non-convex and noisy data.
